turns.prompt_text: can you make baking soda paste out of baking soda
turns.response_html:
Yes, you can easily make a baking soda paste by mixing baking soda with a small amount of water until it forms a thick, spreadable consistency.

A common starting point is a ratio of about 1/2 cup of baking soda to 3 tablespoons of water, but you can adjust the amount of water until you get the paste you want.

For cleaning, you can also add a few drops of dish soap for extra degreasing power.
